Q192.reason: The friend agreed only to get the young man arrested and never intended the burglary to succeed, so he lacks the intent needed for conspiracy or accomplice liability.

Q193.reason: Under Plyler v. Doe, a fee that effectively excludes children of undocumented aliens from public school is not substantially related to an important governmental interest.

Q194.reason: The seller failed to deliver 10 of the 500 widgets, a breach of the single-delivery contract, so the buyer can recover damages even though the rest was accepted and paid for.
